result:
The regression test phase for 002-us-tags passed: all 6 checks (R1–R6, 25 sub-checks) passed on the runner's fresh test database, and no bugs were filed. That was the last test phase, so the suite is now **complete**.

- **R1, backend phase-01 C1–C6:** all hold. The verify script needed approval in this session, as it did in earlier ones, so I ran the same calls as chained curl commands (`curl.log`, requests #01–#37).
- **R2, backend phase-02:**
  - The live swagger matches the tags contract.
  - The app-wide `openapi.json` copy has the same paths and components as the live swagger (41 operations each).
  - Empty, null or missing `tags` bodies get a 400 on the `tags` field; unknown task ids get a 404.
  - The dashboard's due-today task includes its tags.
- **R3 and R4, frontend phases 01 and 02:** checked with headless Playwright; every tag action was done in the UI (14 screenshots).
  - Tasks read back through the API match what the UI shows, and the rows under the "work" filter match the API exactly.
  - The UI texts, the tag filter disabled in the Overdue view, adding a tag with Enter, and the build log are all as expected.
  - The browser console shows only the 3 expected 400s from the rejected tags.
- **R5, unit tests:** backend 386 passed, 0 failed. The frontend has no unit tests configured.
- **R6, coverage:** domain line coverage is 715/734 = 97.4%, against an 80% minimum. The runner reported coverage as skipped, so I added it up from `jacoco.csv`.

For R4 C8, my first read of the "Tags added" notice after pressing Enter came back empty. That was a mistake in my script: two notices were on screen and my locator failed on the second match. The retry read the notice 26 ms after Enter. The report says so and no bug was filed.

As in the suite plan, nothing checks that tags survive an app restart (FR-008), because sessions never restart the app.

I updated the checklist, `suite.json` and the progress log; the runner does the commit. The full report is `loops/testing/outputs/002-us-tags/suite/test-phase-regression-report.md`, and the evidence is in `loops/testing/runs/002-us-tags/suite/test-phase-regression/attempt-1/`.
